target_instance.note: The plan documents port 8189 for the 0.34 test instance. Comfy Desktop may expose it on 8188 when the 0.33.1 main instance is not running, so the runner verifies comfyui_version instead of trusting the port.

invariants.note: Only the output stage changes relative to the CreateVideo/SaveVideo route, so every number here is comparable with artifacts/h3_1080_probe_*_run.json.

fidelity_gates.measured_baseline_note: The 5-frame reference run encoded at luma PSNR 40.66 dB / RGB PSNR 37.57 dB / MAD 2.349 against its own PNGs, so these gates sit below the observed CRF 18 baseline rather than above it.

frames.counter_origin_note: Native ComfyUI SaveImage numbers a batch from 1, not 0. The plan's frame_00000 shape is not reachable without a custom output node, so the validator requires a contiguous 1..frames run inside a per-run directory instead.

1080_stream_5.description: Five-frame frame-sequence smoke test; confirms wiring, naming and per-run isolation.

1080_stream_22.description: Twenty-two-frame frame-sequence smoke test; first profile with a CreateVideo baseline to compare peaks against.

1080_stream_73.description: Seventy-three-frame rerun of the last profile the CreateVideo route completed; optional direct A/B of peak RAM.

1080_stream_90.description: Ninety frames / 3.75 seconds. The CreateVideo route died here at 31.11 GiB; this is the first acceptance target of the streaming route.

1080_stream_107.description: One hundred and seven frames / 4.46 seconds. Run only after 90 frames fully passes.

1080_stream_124.description: One hundred and twenty-four frames / 5.17 seconds. Run only after 107 frames fully passes.

classification.recommended: Completed with at least 0.75 GiB physical RAM headroom at every stage peak.
classification.boundary: Completed, but some stage peak left less than 0.75 GiB headroom; human-supervised runs only.
classification.negative_control: Hit the RAM abort or needed pagefile pressure to finish; evidence only, never in the daily menu.
